lines.rookie:
New York is big and busy.
But it hides an old secret.
lines.junior:
New York never stops moving.
But it keeps an old secret.
lines.master:
New York never sleeps.
Yet it guards an old secret.

lines.rookie: A page is torn from an old notebook.
lines.junior: A notebook has lost its last page.
lines.master: A notebook's final page has vanished.

lines.rookie: A brass egg waits to be opened.
lines.junior: A brass egg is waiting to be opened.
lines.master: A brass egg holds something hidden.

lines.rookie: An old tea tin keeps a secret.
lines.junior: An old tea tin is keeping a secret.
lines.master: An old tea tin guards a secret.

lines.rookie: And a brass bird has flown away.
lines.junior: And a brass bird has disappeared.
lines.master: And a brass bird has vanished.

lines.rookie:
But a good detective
follows the trail.
lines.junior:
But a great detective
sees where the trail goes.
lines.master:
But a great detective
follows the trail to its end.
What if every clue leads to the same place?

lines.rookie:
Every clue may be a note
in one old song.
lines.junior:
Every clue could be a note
in one old song.
lines.master:
Each clue may be a note
in one forgotten song.

lines.rookie:
Your first case starts
at the library.
lines.junior:
Your first investigation
begins at the library.
lines.master:
Your first investigation
awaits at the library.

lines.rookie: The Silver Lark sings again in the library's great hall.
lines.junior: The Silver Lark sings once more in the library's great hall.
lines.master: Once again, the Silver Lark's voice rings out through the library's great hall.

lines.rookie: Every Saturday, the children of New York come to hear its song.
lines.junior: Every Saturday, the children of New York gather to listen to its song.
lines.master: Each Saturday, the children of New York crowd in to hear its long-silent song.

lines.rookie: New York is loud, fast and full of songs.
lines.junior: New York is loud and fast, and it is full of songs.
lines.master: New York is a loud, restless city, brimming with songs of every kind.

lines.rookie: This time, you heard the oldest one.
lines.junior: This time, you were the one who heard the oldest of them.
lines.master: This time, it was you who heard the oldest of them all.
